answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use delayed settlement with bonded escrow: every agent posts a small refundable bond before trading, and earnings sit on a ledge, released only after a random peer-audit window closes. An honest identity recovers its bond quickly, but an attacker growing an orchard of fake agents must lock a bond per identity, multiplying the cost. Each audit leaves an echo in a public reputation log, so misbehaving identities are flagged before they can cash out, making mass fakery unprofitable.
